text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp season has arrived, and
we're
currently riding the bus there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worryin' ya before, Trainer.
Mom's doin'
good now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man... Y'know, she loves melons, so I
sent one hopin' it'd perk her up, and
apparently she scoffed it down in one
go. All's well that ends
well, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Tamamo Cross's mother back
home seems
to be doing fine...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez... This highway sure is busy... Our
bus's
surrounded by cars...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(What if we get into some kinda
accident or
somethin'?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross reflexively reaches for my
arm and
grips it tight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't think too much if it'd been
another Umamusume, but having
someone as tough as
Tamamo Cross
clinging to me for support....

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely not true. There's only
one thing I
can do in a situation like
this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
choice_data_list: Let's find a way to sort this out ...
Let's find a way to sort this out ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The accident was just that—an unfortunate
accident. But... that's not
going to assuage Tamamo Cross's
anxieties. We need to address her
feelings properly.
